tvShows.description:
After a ten-year ‘Vanvaas' of jail, Tulsi returns home! But amid broken family ties, will she be able to revive the long-lost glow of Shantiniketan?
 Watch Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi - Hindi Drama Family serial on JioHotstar now.
